Select distinct molecule ChEMBL ID as chembl_id, compound name, and canonical SMILES for compounds reported in the specified document. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id. Left join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical SMILES. Filter by document ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5725679. Sort by chembl_id, compound name, and canonical SMILES.
